name: MuSR
intro: MuSR 是面向自然长叙事中多步软推理的英文基准。论文通过领域模板、黄金与多样性事实、GPT-4 递归推理树、树校验器、分章节故事生成和事实一致性校验，构建 564 篇叙事与 756 道问题，覆盖谋杀谜案、物体放置和团队分配。
build_method: 神经符号生成, 自动生成, 人工验证, 混合
eval_feature: 递归推理树, 章节化叙事, 树与故事校验器, 思维链与神经符号评测
build_method_en: Neurosymbolic Generation, Automated Generation, Human Validation, Hybrid
eval_feature_en: Recursive Reasoning Trees, Chaptered Narratives, Tree and Story Validators, CoT and Neurosymbolic Evaluation
intro_en: MuSR is an English benchmark for multistep soft reasoning in long natural narratives. Its paper builds 564 narratives and 756 questions across murder mystery, object placement, and team allocation through domain templates, gold and diversity facts, GPT-4 recursive reasoning trees, tree validators, chaptered story generation, and fact-consistency checks.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2310.16049 Sections 3–5 and the official MuSR repository and dataset files. The diagrams preserve the three domain templates, gold and diversity facts, GPT-4 recursive reasoning-tree completion, tree validators and retry behavior, the S(T)/C(T) leaf split, chaptered story generation and fact-consistency rewrites, 564-narrative/756-question release with exact domain counts, heuristic and human quality checks, CoT variants, domain-specific neurosymbolic methods, and Accuracy-based human-model comparison.
